bio: Fine Natural Dining is the concept here at this pleasant restaurant. Charming staff serve up fully vegan cuisine in the form of a three- to seven-course tasting menu – it's also possible to order à la carte. Made with seasonal vegetables, the creative, plant-based dishes are packed with flavour, and they are just as popular with international visitors as they are with locals. In summer, the best place to dine is on the terrace out front....
